about_the_game:
Avant-Garde: Napoleonic Battles brings you into the heart of the great Napoleonic battles, in a real-time strategy game on a hexagonal grid where every choice counts.

You take the place of the greatest generals of the era. You observe the terrain, sense the weather, gauge the morale of your troops, and adjust your forces. Key events unfold: the arrival of reinforcements, the death of a general, the explosion of a building… Every moment can transform the fate of the battle.

You can follow the historical course and test your strategic skills under the same conditions as your predecessors. Or you can change the outcome: reorganize your troops, experiment with troop numbers, anticipate or provoke decisive events. History is your playground, but beware, every decision has consequences.

Are you capable of surpassing Napoleon and the generals of the past and leaving your mark on history?

Key Features:

  • Historically Authentic Battles:
    Terrain, weather, units, and events faithfully reflect the battles of the Napoleonic era

  • Command Key Figures:
    Embody Napoleon or his main rivals and relive their strategic decisions

  • Experiment with Troop Sizes:
    Adjust armies to test alternative scenarios and explore different strategies

  • Manage Key Events:
    Anticipate, trigger, or deflect the decisive moments that shaped the outcome of battles

  • Diverse and Detailed Units:
    Infantry, sappers, cavalry, and artillery, each with its own specific strengths, weaknesses, and formations

  • Accessible Strategic Interface:
    Simple or advanced orders depending on your experience with the real-time strategy genre

You maneuver on the same terrain as the generals of the era, under realistic weather conditions. Every enemy move follows a historical logic, and each unit possesses specific attributes: morale, ammunition, skills, and formations. History sets the stage… your decisions shape the outcome.

The battle is raging. Reinforcements arrive, buildings explode, and leaders fall in combat. You must anticipate, provoke, or avert these decisive moments. Each event presents an opportunity, or a danger, that you can exploit to gain the upper hand and transform a critical situation into a decisive victory.


Clear and concise tutorial: Avant-Garde offers a simple learning curve so every player can quickly grasp the game mechanics.

Two attack modes: choose between auto-attack for simplified control or precise attack for complete strategic command.

Whether you're a beginner or an expert, the path to glory is within your reach.
